sources.title: Zhiwei Xu - Homepage
sources.snippet: Welcome to Zhiwei Xu 's Homepage! I am currently an assistant professor at the School of Artificial Intelligence, Shandong University, and a member of the General Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (SDU GAIL). I received my Ph.D. degree from the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, advised by Prof. Guoliang Fan (范国梁).

sources.title: actionaudit · PyPI
sources.snippet: No network calls during a scan, no AI in the core. The same input always produces the same output. Educational. Every finding explains the risk and the fix, not just the rule name. actionaudit explain <rule> gives the full background. Standards-aligned. Every rule maps to an OWASP Top 10 CI/CD Security Risk. Multiple output formats.
